root_cause.text: The `invalidate_complete` function in the dm-cache subsystem unconditionally dereferences `mg->cell` to unlock and free a prison cell without verifying it is non-NULL, causing a crash when concurrent writes prevent the cell from being acquired during cache invalidation in passthrough mode.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies `drivers/md/dm-cache-target.c` to wrap the `dm_cell_unlock_v2` and `free_prison_cell` calls in an `if (mg->cell)` check, addressing the CVE description stating that `mg->cell` remains NULL when the bio prison cell lock fails due to concurrent writes.

vuln_statements.explanation: Based on the vulnerability root cause, the invalidate_complete function unconditionally dereferences mg->cell without NULL verification. This statement directly accesses mg->cell to unlock a prison cell, which will cause a NULL pointer dereference crash when concurrent writes prevent cell acquisition during cache invalidation in passthrough mode. The absence of a NULL check before this dereference is the core vulnerability.
